root_causes: canonical B3B sprite faces screen-left but anatomical near/far and left/right ownership were never registered against that authored 3/4 view
G2 screen-space motion deltas were applied to an unrelated authored sprite rest pose/camera basis without a validated sprite-to-rig rest registration
walk motion contains essential camera-depth/foreshortening changes that cannot be represented by 2D chain-angle warping alone
a single monolithic 3/4 raster does not contain hidden limb/body surfaces needed when occlusion order changes across a stride
continuous warp therefore stretches existing visible pixels into anatomically impossible arcs/loops instead of producing valid new pose silhouettes
grounding by per-frame alpha-bbox bottom is not a valid substitute for contact-foot/root grounding
closed_methods: hard cutout limb rotation from one monolithic sprite
continuous chain warp from one monolithic sprite
further pivot/anchor/overlap tuning of the same single-still puppet approach

retained.G3V_R_DIRECTION_SPACE_FK: retained as hidden motion/retarget infrastructure only

next_architectural_requirement: animation-ready native 2D source must contain pose-specific visible information; for walk, use persistent authored pose-family/key sprites or an equivalent native-2D representation with valid near/far limb and occlusion ownership. Do not attempt to infer a full walk from the single B3B still by warping.
